messages.text: 有冇人同我一齊坐minibus返去 😂

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 同你講一樣：個charity 5k個group我想開個細啲嘅，淨係slow group兩三個，你想唔想入？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 簡單啲嘅，人少啲，易啲搞。你覺得點

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好 你慢慢諗，今晚見

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: omg my telescope sketch is so bad

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: its not bad! the crater bit is nice

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: lol i smudged it with my hand

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: smudged is realistic, real moons are messy

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: did u get the email about the meteor shower

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: yep, thursday night, 11ish, hill car park. Your mum has the form already

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: great. oh btw can u bring the red torchh, i cant find the spare

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i think its in my bag

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: wait going back to the sketch, should i colour it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nah, pencil is better for the dark

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: if you have any star questions you can message me any time, even late, im usually up observing anyway

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: my mum takes my phone at 9 tho

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: oh of course, thats fine, daytime is good

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我張星空素描畫得好難睇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔係喎 月球嗰啲坑畫得幾好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 抹花咗更似真 月亮本來就唔平滑

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 你收唔收到封email 講流星雨

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 收到 星期四十一點 山上個停車場 你媽咪簽咗表喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好 對咗 你可唔可以帶個紅色電筒 我搵唔到多一個

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 返轉頭 張畫要唔要上色

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使 鉛筆喺黑暗度好啲

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 對咗 你係今次組入面最有心嘅 下次我可以借我私人嗰支望遠鏡畀你用

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 當然 問咗媽咪先啦 唔緊要

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我哋班今日有人帶咗隻龜返學 好搞笑

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好細隻 佢叫咗佢做炸彈 lol

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哇 好清 有冇用望遠鏡

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我哋班而家好mad 全部人都想睇月亮

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 但係個老師話夜晚唔准出

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 呢個無辦法 可以喺窗口睇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 返轉頭 星期四個form 我媽咪簽咗

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 另外我想問你 星期三夜晚得唔得閒 我哋call一陣 睇下個chart

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁用你屋企部電話 或者用你媽咪個

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使問 你自己call我就得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我想問問佢 因為佢話夜晚唔准call 我唔想違規
